description: This file defines a Flutter widget called 'BestSellers' which displays a horizontal list of product cards for best-selling products. It constructs a UI component with a title and a list of 'ProductCard' widgets, sourced from a demo data list, and handles navigation to product detail screens.

classes.name: BestSellers
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a list of best-selling products in a horizontal scroll view.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the BestSellers widget, including title and horizontally scrolling list of ProductCards.
